name: THE HALLOWEEN HOUSE
source:
THE HALLOWEEN HOUSE is a horror visual novel with point-and-click elements and nostalgic graphics.  You join two children, Crystal and Zachary, on their adventure on Halloween. While searching for more houses to trick-or-treat at, they stumble across a home on the outskirts of their small town.

[from [url=https://harlequinngames.itch.io/the-halloween-house]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《THE HALLOWEEN HOUSE》是一部採用懷舊畫面、融入指向點選探索的恐怖視覺小說。萬聖節這天，你將與克里斯特爾和扎卡里兩個孩子一起冒險。他們還想再找幾家討些糖果，結果無意間發現了小鎮邊緣的一棟住宅。

［摘自[url=https://harlequinngames.itch.io/the-halloween-house]itch.io[/url]］
